question.text: High interest rates impact commodity prices through all of the following channels EXCEPT:

answer.text: By increasing the demand for physical storage of commodities
By increasing the incentive for extraction today rather than tomorrow
By decreasing firms' desire to carry inventories

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook, high interest rates work through four channels: (1) increase the incentive for extraction today rather than tomorrow, (2) decrease firms' desire to carry inventories, (3) shift investments toward treasury bills, and (4) appreciate the domestic currency. The workbook describes the effect as almost instantaneous. The Trap: All other options correctly describe channels listed in the workbook. The incorrect option reverses the inventory effect — high rates raise the cost of carrying inventory, so storage demand falls, not rises. Note: The workbook does not characterise this relationship as medium-term, nor does it cite RBI specifically on this page.
